desc: s holds lowercase words separated by single spaces (s may be "", giving ""). Translate each word and rejoin with single spaces. The letters a, e, i, o and u are vowels, with two exceptions: a "u" directly after a "q" is not a vowel, and "y" is a vowel except when it is the first letter of the word. If the word starts with a vowel, append "way". Otherwise move the letters before the first vowel to the end of the word and append "ay". If the word has no vowel at all, just append "ay".
